tools.name: test_pack_builder
tools.description: Run the review-before-code test-pack workflow: extract requirements, classify them, produce human-readable test cases and a traceability matrix, then stop at a review gate.

sources.description: Ordered source references (PRD, acceptance criteria, Figma, repo, staging). At least one grounded source is required for traceability.

scope.description: Optional scope note or target flow.

tools.name: requirement_extraction
tools.description: Extract grounded requirements from a PRD or acceptance criteria and classify each by approved type.

tools.name: playwright_spec_generation
tools.description: Generate @playwright/test specs from an approved test pack, using accessible locators and fixtures with traceability comments.

approved_pack_id.description: ID of a test pack the caller has already approved at the review gate. The runtime MUST resolve this to a pack whose review state is 'approved' and reject unknown, unapproved, or stale packs before generating specs.

base_url_env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the base URL (e.g. STAGING_BASE_URL). Must be an env-var name, never a literal URL or credential.

tools.name: repository_analysis
tools.description: Inspect repository conventions (package manager, test runner, Playwright config, fixtures, test-ID conventions). Read-only by default.

tools.name: figma_context_extraction
tools.description: Extract UI states, breakpoints, content hierarchy, and component expectations from a Figma reference as design evidence (read-only).
